question: What is the meaning of documentation on collection during the end-of-life of a product in relation to life-cycle data?
data_point: documentation on collection during the end-of-life of a product
description: Documentation on collection during the end-of-life of a product refers to the process of gathering and recording information about the product's materials and components as it is being disposed of or recycled. This documentation is part of life-cycle data, which includes details such as the product's sales volume and can provide insights into the expected volume of waste and the potential for recycling resources. By collecting this data, businesses can assess the environmental and social impact of the product throughout its life cycle, from origin to disposal. This information can be used to optimize the design, production, usage, and disposal of products, supporting circular economy objectives and ensuring supply chain transparency. <||>
